rules.description: Verify MinDate is 1990 and MaxDate is >= 2021.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate FROM stats
params.condition: TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INT) = 1990 AND TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INT) >= 2021
